activity.notes: Edward Lewis 'Bob' Bartlett was appointed secretary of Alaska on 30 January 1939 and served until resigning on 6 February 1944. ATLAS records this as service to the Territory of Alaska, not as rulership of Alaska.

sources.title: BARTLETT, Edward Lewis (Bob) — U.S. House of Representatives: History, Art & Archives
sources.citation_text: The official congressional biography records Bartlett's appointment as secretary of Alaska on 30 January 1939 and resignation on 6 February 1944.
